results.question: Which appointments have a status of No-Show?
results.ground_truth_sql:

results.question: List all root canal treatments performed by Dr. Sarah Chen.
results.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT t.procedure_name, a.appointment_date FROM treatments t
        JOIN appointments a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id
        JOIN dentists d ON a.dentist_id = d.dentist_id
        WHERE d.full_name = 'Dr. Sarah Chen' AND t.procedure_name LIKE 'Root Canal%';

results.question: What is the total invoice amount due for each insurance provider?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(i.amount_due) AS total_amount_due, p.insurance_provider FROM invoices i INNER JOIN patients p ON i.patient_id = p.patient_id GROUP BY p.insurance_provider;

results.question: Which dentist has performed the most treatments?
results.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT d.full_name, COUNT(*) AS treatment_count
        FROM treatments t JOIN appointments a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id
        JOIN dentists d ON a.dentist_id = d.dentist_id
        GROUP BY d.full_name ORDER BY treatment_count DESC LIMIT 1;
results.generated_sql: SELECT T1.full_name FROM dentists AS T1 INNER JOIN appointments AS T2 ON T1.dentist_id = T2.dentist_id INNER JOIN treatments AS T3 ON T2.appointment_id = T3.appointment_id GROUP BY T1.dentist_id ORDER BY COUNT(T3.treatment_id) DESC LIMIT 1;
